title: Automated Protein Quantification with the Biomek-FX Liquid Handler System
author: Yan Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b3grqjv6
materials: Open Biomek Software that controls Biomek-FX liquid handler system. Under "File" drop-down menu, click "Open" to select the automation method "Modular Protein Quantitation method." Because different deck orientations and system components are possible, you will need to modify the method file (attached in the 'Before start' section) for your specific Biomek liquid handler system.
After 5 min, click OK to resume method.

steps.title: Open Instrument Setup
steps.instruction: Click on “Instrument Setup” under the “Setup” group node to view the visual instructions for configuring the Biomek‑FX deck.

steps.title: Configure Deck Layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck‑setup picture, placing all required labware (Protein Read plates, Control Read plate, Titrate plate, BSA Standards plate, etc.) in the specified positions.

steps.title: Manually Mix Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, mix all protein samples thoroughly right before starting the automated method.

steps.title: Start Automated Run
steps.instruction: Click the green “Run” button (arrow) to launch the Biomek‑FX protocol.

steps.title: Add Buffer A to Read Plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 25 µL of Buffer A to each well of Protein Read plate 1, Protein Read plate 2, and the Control Read plate.

steps.title: Prepare Titration Plate
steps.instruction: First add 12 µL of H₂O to each well of the Titrate plate; then transfer 3 µL from the Protein plate to the Titrate plate and mix by performing 5 cycles of pipette mixing on the deck.

substeps.instruction: Add 12 µL H₂O to Titrate plate wells.
Transfer 3 µL protein from Protein plate to Titrate plate.

steps.title: Transfer Diluted Protein to Read Plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL of the diluted protein from the Titrate plate to the corresponding wells of Protein Read plate 1 and Protein Read plate 2.

steps.title: Prepare BSA Standards and Add to Control Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the BSA Standards plate (rows A‑D): add 40 µL H₂O to wells A1‑D1, then add 40 µL of each BSA standard (125 µg/mL to 2000 µg/mL) into columns 2‑8; finally transfer 5 µL of each standard to the Control Read plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL H₂O to wells A1‑D1.
Add 40 µL BSA Standard 1 (125 µg/mL) through Standard 7 (2000 µg/mL) into columns 2‑8.
Transfer 5 µL of each BSA standard to the Control Read plate.

steps.title: Pause for 5‑Minute Incubation
steps.instruction: The method will pause; set a timer for 5 minutes and resume the protocol after the timer expires.

steps.title: Add Buffer B and Incubate 10 min
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of Buffer B to each of the three Read plates and incubate for 00:10:00 (10 minutes). The method will pause; set a 10‑minute timer and click OK to continue after the incubation.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer B to each Read plate.

steps.title: Read Plates on Spectramax 250
steps.instruction: Move the three plates to the MD Spectramax 250 microplate reader and measure absorbance at 750 nm to obtain raw protein concentrations.

steps.title: Calculate Concentrations and Apply Dilution Factor
steps.instruction: Read Protein Read plate 1 and Protein Read plate 2; multiply the obtained protein concentrations by 5 to correct for the five‑fold dilution performed in step 7. Also multiply results by any user‑defined dilution factor from step 7 if the water‑protein volumes were altered.

steps.title: Store Protein Plate at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Place the protein plate at –20 °C until it is needed for the subsequent Automated Protein Normalization and Tryptic Digestion on a Biomek‑NX Liquid Handler System.
